heroHeadline: DRC Grants Mota-Engil 30-Year Concession for Lobito Corridor Copper Railway
heroSubtitle: President João Lourenço traveled to Kinshasa to witness the signing of a $1.8 billion, 30-year rail concession linking DRC's copperbelt to Angola's Atlantic port — a rare economic breakthrough even as fighting continues in the Kalehe-Masisi-Walungu corridor and a Beni civil society leader was shot dead overnight.
